999008199.text:
やっと到着……！　ここがピルッツァ……
空気が、なんだか重いような……

localizations.en: We're finally here...! So this is Piruzza... The air feels kind of... heavy...

999008199.text:
うぅ……なんか、のどがイガイガする……
頭もぼーっとしてきたかも……

localizations.en: Ugh... my throat feels all scratchy... My head's starting to spin too...

999008199.text:
え、ちょっと待って、アタシも息苦しさが……
これ、空気のせい？

localizations.en: Wait, I'm having trouble breathing too... Is it the air?

999008199.text:
……みんな、すぐに船に戻るわよ！　
この空気、ただごとじゃない！

localizations.en: Everyone, back to the ship! Now! Something's very wrong with this air!

999008199.text: ったく、一息つく間もないとはね！

localizations.en: Can't even catch our breath, can we!

999008199.text:
はぁ、はぁ……
すみません、私、ちょっと……体調が……

localizations.en: Hah... hah... I'm sorry, I don't feel so... well...

999008199.text:
目の前がぐるぐるしてる……
なんなの、これぇ……

localizations.en: Everything's going all... wobbly... What is this...?

999008199.text:
あれは……きっとキノコの胞子だね。
景色をくすませる、いけ好かないやつだよ

localizations.en: Those would be mushroom spores. Nasty little things that cloud everything in their path.

999008199.text:
キノコの島だとは聞いてたけど、まさか毒キノコ？
住民はみんな、こんな中で暮らしてるの……？

localizations.en: I knew this was a mushroom island, but poisonous ones? Are the people here living in this all the time...?

999008199.text:
こ……こんなこともあろうかと、
船に色んな薬の備蓄を、用意してあります……！

localizations.en: J-just in case something like this happened... I stocked the ship with all kinds of medicines...!

999008199.text: 本当……！？　さすがレスナちゃん……！

ダメだ。
薬を飲ませても、一向に良くなる気配がない

localizations.en: It's no good. The medicine isn't helping. No sign of improvement at all.

999008199.text: 従来の風邪や病とは違うってことね

localizations.en: So this isn't like an ordinary cold or illness.

999008199.text:
ピルッツァの島全体があの胞子に覆われてるっぽいよ？
もしかしたら、島の人たちも無事じゃないかもね

localizations.en: Looks like the spores have blanketed the entire island. The locals might not be doing so well either.

999008199.text:
ならなおさら、なんで私たちは無事なの？
やっぱり例によって……

localizations.en: Then why are the rest of us fine? Don't tell me it's because...

999008199.text:
うん、ホムンクルスだから、だと思う。
私も、平気だよ

localizations.en: Yeah... I think it's because we're homunculi. I feel fine too.

999008199.text:
肯定。ホムンクルスは環境変化に強い。
私も異常なし

localizations.en: Affirmative. Homunculi are resilient to environmental changes. No abnormalities detected.

999008199.text:
なら、私たちで島の調査に行くしかないわね。
レスナたちは無理しないで、しばらく船で待機してて

localizations.en: Then it's up to us to investigate the island. Resna, the rest of you stay on the ship and rest. Don't push yourselves.

999008199.text: ありがとう……調査、気を付けてね

localizations.en: Thank you... Please be careful out there.

999008199.text:
よし、みんな準備はいい？　
ピルッツァの謎を解き明かしに行くわよ！

localizations.en: Alright, is everyone ready? Let's go find out what's going on with Piruzza!
